systems.owner: the competent civil registry authority (not named)
systems.tiers: not stated; refugees and asylum-seekers may register births, deaths and marriages on the same terms as nationals, with access limited for both by accessibility, awareness and availability of services; nothing said of how records are made

systems.system: leniency measure for late birth registration of refugee children
systems.tiers: Goma and South Kivu (over 2,500 refugee children, to 30 June 2023) and Aru (2,750 South Sudanese refugee children), bypassing the judicial procedure for late registration

systems.system: refugee identity cards and asylum-seeker attestations
systems.owner: Secretariat of the Commission Nationale pour les Réfugiés (CNR), under the Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: CNR Permanent Secretariat and provincial branches; 16 per cent of refugees held a CNR card in 2022

systems.system: refugee management database (registration, proof of registration)
systems.owner: UNHCR, which maintains it; handover of registration to the Ministry of Interior planned for 2021 did not materialise
systems.tiers: not stated; 74.37 per cent of refugees and asylum-seekers individually registered in 2022

systems.owner: Office National d'Identification de la Population (ONIP)
systems.tiers: none: to be provided 'in the long run'

note: The document says refugees may register vital events with the civil registry on the same terms as nationals and that implementation is limited; it does not describe how any office records a birth or death, on paper or digitally, so there is no fact.
